title: Jeroboam II Restores Israel's Borders
description: King Jeroboam II becomes king over Israel in Samaria and restores the country's borders from Lebo-Hamah to the Sea of the Arabah, just as the prophet Jonah son of Amittai had predicted. The Lord sees Israel's bitter distress and saves the people through Jeroboam, even though the king does what is evil in the Lord's sight.
